headline: What comes back.
lede: What the sheet does, in plain words. Then *four places it does not add up.*

blocks.label: What it does
blocks.text: Monthly revenue by client, with a forecast that rolls three months forward.

blocks.label: Inputs and calculations
blocks.text: Columns B to D are typed in. Everything else is a formula.

items.text: The total in F42 sums F2 to F40. Row 41 is left out.
Column D mixes £ and plain numbers in 14 rows.
H17 is typed as 0.85. Every other row uses the rate on the Inputs tab.
The tab called Old forecast still feeds cell C6.
